name: qualified-time-select-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.time version FROM items AS i) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: qualified-time-select-quoted-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.time "version" FROM items AS i) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: qualified-time-select-explicit-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.time AS version FROM items AS i) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: qualified-quoted-time-select-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i."time" version FROM items AS i) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: qualified-version-select-time
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.version time FROM items AS i) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: qualified-time-select-operand
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.time + i.version AS value FROM items AS i) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: qualified-time-returning-alias
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING items.time version;

name: qualified-version-returning-time
sql: UPDATE items SET name = 'changed' RETURNING items.version time;

name: relation-bare-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM items version) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-explicit-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM items AS version) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-quoted-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM items "version") UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-qualified-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM public.items version) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-only-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM ONLY (items) version) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-join-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.id FROM items i JOIN items version ON i.id = version.id) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-comma-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.id FROM items i, items version) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-derived-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT x FROM (SELECT 1 AS x) version) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-lateral-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT x FROM LATERAL (SELECT 1 AS x) version) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-function-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 1 FROM generate_series(1, 2) version) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-ordinality-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 1 FROM generate_series(1, 2) WITH ORDINALITY version) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-column-list
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT x FROM items i(version, x, y, z)) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-column-list-explicit
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT x FROM items AS i(version, x, y, z)) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-parenthesized-join-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 1 FROM (items a JOIN items b USING (id)) version) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-qualified-column
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT version.version FROM items version) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-join-on-column
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.id FROM items i JOIN items j ON j.version = i.id) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-where-column
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM items i WHERE version = 0) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-function-argument
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT n FROM items i, LATERAL generate_series(0, i.version) seq(n)) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-distinct-from-column
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 0 IS DISTINCT FROM version FROM items i) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: relation-function-from-operand
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT substring('abc' FROM version + 1) AS value FROM items i) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';
